rules: Each concept has a stable identifier, one-line description, optional clear specializes relations, and optional exemplar anchors that address exact Events or fragments.
The first scored run uses no representative prototype and no scored canonical Meaning Model.
The five concern concepts are a frozen first-run comparison vocabulary, not a universal decomposition required by the Meaning Model.
Fear remains an emotion downstream of a threat belief; neither fear nor meanness is an approach or threat-avoidance pole.
Care is encoded as an AtomicWant leaf type directed at an addressable endpoint concerning another person and is evidence for, never the definition of, kindness.
Every custom concept must serve generation, validation, rendering, or evaluation.
meanness_rule: Meanness is an unweighted evaluative Realization of an episode expected to be a negative exemplar under a versioned kindness grounding. The Realization's perspective derives from its parent ancestry rather than a stored field. Meanness is not a concern pole, emotion, problem-solving mode, or ordinal score. Any graded fit uses a separate match/nonmatch/remainder Cut.

anchor_shape.target_record_id: an exact Event or addressable fragment identifier
anchor_shape.expected_judgment: the expected applies or does-not-apply judgment; no degree is stored on the anchor or Realization

anchor_contract.context_rule: An anchor contains no holder or perspective field. When an anchor is used in a perspective-dependent assessment, that context derives from the assessment Event or surface node that parents the Realization and any fit Cut.
anchor_contract.evidence_pointer_rule: A document, dataset, or other Thing may support a definition but is an evidence_pointer, not an exemplar anchor. It becomes an anchor only after an exact Event or fragment inside it is addressable.
anchor_contract.freeze_rule: Any concept used by a Realization must have its required exemplar anchors frozen. Realizations are unweighted; any graded fit is a separate Cut over mutually exclusive match, nonmatch, and remainder answers.

concern_coverage_contract.vocabulary_scope: shared across principals in this construction only
concern_coverage_contract.revision_rule: If concern remainder coverage exceeds the frozen threshold over the frozen window, the vocabulary is revised under a new explicit version; existing Cuts retain their original vocabulary version.

emotion.label: joy
emotion.description: Positive appraisal of an obtained or approaching wanted state.

emotion.label: sadness
emotion.description: Appraisal of loss, absence, or obstruction without itself implying an active threat response.

emotion.label: fear
emotion.description: Belief-conditioned anticipation that a wanted region will be obstructed or lost.

emotion.label: anger
emotion.description: Appraisal of obstruction or violation that mobilizes contest, correction, or defense.

emotion.label: disgust
emotion.description: Rejection or avoidance of perceived contamination, degradation, or boundary violation.

emotion.label: surprise
emotion.description: Appraisal produced when a realized continuation carried low prior weight on the applicable perspective ancestry.

emotion.label: trust
emotion.description: Presently felt willingness to rely on a person, institution, or mechanism while vulnerable to its action.

emotion.label: anticipation
emotion.description: Prospective emotional orientation toward one or more weighted continuations.

emotion.label: neutral
emotion.description: An actively low-valence, low-arousal, or balanced supported state; it is not the unresolved remainder.

concern.label: belonging
concern.description: First-run concern for connection, membership, or recognized inclusion, with rejection or exclusion as its threat reading.

concern.label: competence
concern.description: First-run concern for effective action, mastery, or achievement, with failure or incapacity as its threat reading.

concern.label: autonomy
concern.description: First-run concern for self-direction and meaningful control, with coercion or loss of control as its threat reading.

concern.label: understanding
concern.description: First-run concern for intelligibility, information, and usable options, with uncertainty or the unknown as its threat reading.

concern.label: well-being
concern.description: First-run concern for bodily integrity, comfort, and viability, with pain or suffering as its threat reading.

custom.label: uniform screw-thread system
custom.description: A proposed shared system of screw-thread form and dimensions derived from comparative measurement, distinct from the paper that describes it and from later institutional adoption.

custom.label: scope freeze
custom.description: A commitment that fixes the supported production configuration while routing later improvements into explicit change control or a successor design.

custom.label: independent works authority
custom.description: Delegated authority to reject, schedule, cost, manufacture, and test a production configuration without silent architectural override.

custom.label: verified calculation service
custom.description: A service that delivers bounded calculations with declared inputs, independent comparison, correction records, acceptance criteria, and responsibility for error classes.

custom.label: conditional negotiation
custom.description: Continue engagement while making commitment contingent on explicit terms, authority, evidence, or performance gates.

custom.label: staged commitment
custom.description: Commit a bounded reversible stage before exposing the whole project or relationship to an uncertain continuation.

custom.label: evidence-triggered revision
custom.description: Preserve a current commitment until a named observation or failed test justifies an explicit revision rather than silent drift.

custom.label: shock
custom.description: A perturbing Event relative to one or more named longer Event-processes, linked to those affected processes. Change is recorded only as a comparison derived from compatible Cuts or as same-unit world data under an externally meaningful measurement protocol; the Event has no generic magnitude.

custom.label: adaptation
custom.description: A process trajectory around change, including pre-event adjustment to an anticipated transition, post-event recovery or consolidation, continuing drift, instability or cascade, and terminal transition.

custom.label: historically premature architecture
custom.description: An architecture whose organizing idea becomes available before the manufacturing, financing, governance, labor, or social institutions needed to realize it reliably.

custom.label: situated intelligence
custom.description: An evaluation, scoped by its parent ancestry, of whether an episode organizes available information and a fitting strategy under its actual constraints, distinguished from luck and retrospective outcome. Its `describe` Realization is unweighted; any graded fit uses a separate match/nonmatch/remainder Cut.

custom.label: kindness
custom.description: An evaluation, scoped by its parent ancestry, of conduct given the actor's available knowledge, consequences for affected people, reversibility, and respect for those people's represented wants and agency; an attributed care motive is evidence but never its definition. Its `describe` Realization is unweighted; any graded fit uses a separate match/nonmatch/remainder Cut.

custom.label: contribution
custom.description: Causally relevant work toward one bounded result, kept separate from ownership, authority, and later public credit.

custom.label: recognition
custom.description: An attribution of credit, status, or acknowledgment to a contributor, scoped by the attributing Event's parent ancestry or by a registered institution, which may diverge from contribution evidence.

custom.label: framing
custom.description: Directing problem-solving attention toward identifying and representing the problem to be solved.

custom.label: deciding
custom.description: Directing problem-solving attention toward selecting or committing among represented alternatives.

custom.label: concrete
custom.description: Framing through particular materials, observations, cases, or immediately executable constraints.

custom.label: abstract
custom.description: Framing through general relations, principles, representations, or cases beyond the immediate instance.

custom.label: impartial
custom.description: Deciding by applying the represented considerations without changing their force solely because of who is involved.

custom.label: personal
custom.description: Deciding with explicit attention to the identities, relationships, and particular consequences for those involved.
